content.text:
## Executive summary

**`g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\LMS-V1` is essentially empty** — only placeholder folders (`Controls\P`, `Pages`) with no source files and no `.csproj` reference. The runnable application is the sibling **`InformationWeb`** project at `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\`, which is a **college CMS / information portal**, not an LMS. There are **no lessons, quizzes, course progress, SCORM, H5P, or interactive content authoring** features in this workspace.

---

## 1. Overall project structure

### LMS-V1 (requested path)

| Path | Status |
|------|--------|
| `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\LMS-V1\Controls\P\` | Empty |
| `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\LMS-V1\Pages\` | Empty |

LMS-V1 appears to be a **future scaffold** for LMS pages/controls, not an implemented module.

### InformationWeb (actual application)

```
g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\
├── InformationWeb.csproj          # .NET Framework 4.0 WebForms
├── InformationWeb.sln
├── BDS.Master                     # Master layout
├── Default.aspx, Router.aspx, InfoRouter.aspx, NotFound.aspx
├── Global.asax.cs                 # Routing, visitor counter
├── Controls\                      # User controls (143 files)
│   ├── InfomationNew\             # News list/detail, home sections
│   ├── InfoSection\               # Legacy CMS sections, enrollment
│   ├── Information\               # About, Khoa/Phòng
│   ├── InformationSection\Information\  # Chatbot (ashx + js)
│   ├── Home.ascx, Banner.ascx, Uploader.ascx, MenuBootstrap_Edu.ascx
│   └── ...
├── Pages\
│   ├── InfomationNew\Search.aspx
│   └── InfoSection\               # N_List, N_ListDetail, DangKyTuyenSinh
├── assets\                        # CSS/JS (Bootstrap, jQuery, theme)
├── App_GlobalResources\           # Lang.resx / LangEn.resx (i18n)
├── App_Themes\Default\
├── Media\                         # Static images (referenced, folder mostly empty in repo)
├── App_Data\ChatLogs\
└── LMS-V1\                        # Empty scaffold
```

### Layer architecture (as designed vs. what exists here)

| Layer | Location | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| **Presentation** | `Controls\`, `Pages\`, `BDS.Master` | WebForms + ASCX user controls |
| **BLL / DAL** | **Not in workspace** | Referenced via DLLs: `InformationWebObject`, `DCore`, `SystemManagement`, `SystemMenu`, etc. |
| **Utility** | Referenced in `.csproj` but **files missing on disk** | `Utility\WebGlobal.cs`, `HtmlContentHelper.cs`, `InfoSlugRoutingService.cs`, etc. |
| **Config** | `Web.config` referenced in `.csproj` but **not present** in workspace | Connection strings likely in `DCore.ConfigManager` |

**Project reference (external):**

- `..\InformationWebObject\InformationWebObject.csproj` — entity/DAL layer (source not in this repo)

**Key DLL dependencies** (`InformationWeb.csproj`):

- `DCore.dll`, `SystemManagement.dll`, `SystemManagementObject.dll`
- `SystemMenu.dll`, `SystemMenuObject.dll`, `CommonControls.dll`
- `AjaxControlToolkit 4.1`, `Telerik.Web.UI 2010.3`
- `HtmlAgilityPack`, `UrlRewritingNet`, `CollectionPager`

---

## 2. Existing features (CMS, not LMS)

This is a **public-facing college website** (Trường Cao đẳng KTCN Quảng Trị), built around **news/information content**.

| Feature | Key files | Data source |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| **Home page sections** | `Controls\Home.ascx`, `Home_Info_Section*.ascx` | `INFO_Information_SIMS_News`, `INFO_AboutPageContent_List` |
| **News/article list** | `List_Info_Section1.ascx.cs` | `INFO_Information_SIMS_List`, `sp_News_Search_New` |
| **Article detail** | `Detail_Info_Section1.ascx.cs` | `INFO_Information_SIMS_Detail` |
| **Slug routing** | `Router.aspx.cs`, `InfoRouter.aspx.cs` | `INFO_Information_Router_GetPostBySlug`, `INFO_Information_List_ByCateSlug` |
| **Search** | `Pages\InfomationNew\Search.aspx` | `sp_News_Search_New` |
| **Banner carousel** | `Banner.ascx.cs` | `INFO_Information_Banner` |
| **About page blocks** | `SectionAbout.ascx.cs`, `AboutPageContentHelper.cs` | `INFO_AboutPageContent_List` (ContentCode-driven) |
| **Career/major listing** | `SectionListNghe.ascx.cs` | `INFO_Career_Search` |
| **Enrollment form (UI only)** | `DangKyTuyensinh.ascx.cs` | **TODO** — no DB save yet |
| **Chatbot** | `ChatApi.ashx.cs`, `ChatSearch.ashx.cs`, `chatbot.js` | `INFO_Information_GET_Chat`, `INFO_Chat_GET_ByKeyword` |
| **Multi-language** | `ResManager`, `Lang.resx`, `Language.ascx` | Session/cookie language switching |
| **Visitor counter** | `Global.asax.cs` | `SYS_Counter` entity |
| **Navigation menu** | `MenuBootstrap_Edu.ascx.cs` | `System_Menu_SearchForWeb` |

### Content types (actual)

- **HTML articles** (`Title`, `Content`, `Brief`, `ThumbImage`, slug `InformationLink`)
- **Categories** (`CategoryID`, `CategoryLink`, `CategoryName`)
- **Information types** (`INFO_InformationType` — used for legacy URL params)
- **About page structured blocks** (`ContentCode`, `Content`, `ImageUrl`, `LinkUrl`, `NumberValue`)
- **Career records** (`INFO_Career`)
- **YouTube embeds** — URL parsing in `SectionAbout.ascx.cs`; theme uses `popup-video` CSS classes
- **PDF in content** — referenced via `HtmlContentHelper.ProcessPdfIframeContent` (file missing from repo)

### What is NOT present

- Lessons / modules / units
- Quizzes / assessments / grading
- Student enrollment in courses
- Learning progress / completion tracking
- Self-hosted video LMS player
- Interactive content packages (H5P, SCORM, xAPI)
- Authoring UI for interactive content

> **Note:** CSS classes like `course-card`, `course-slider` are **theme naming** for news cards, not actual course entities.

---

## 3. Database patterns

### Connection & access pattern

```csharp
INFO_Information info = new INFO_Information();
DataTable dt = info.GetDataTable(
    "INFO_Information_SIMS_Detail",
    "@InformationLink", slug,
    "@LanguageID", languageID
);
```

- **Entity classes** in `InformationWebObject` namespace: `INFO_Information`, `INFO_Category`, `INFO_InformationType`, `INFO_Career`, `System_Menu`, `SYS_Counter`, `SYS_Department`
- **All DB access via stored procedures** through `GetDataTable(procName, paramName, value, ...)`
- **Results as `DataTable` / `DataRow`** — no EF, no LINQ-to-SQL in visible code
- **Error logging:** `new SystemError(SystemConfig.ConnectionString, message, ex)`
- **Config:** `DCore.ConfigManager.GetConfig(...)` for upload paths/sizes
- **Caching:** `HttpRuntime.Cache` for menus (10s) and router (30 min)

### Stored procedures found in code

| Stored procedure | Purpose |
|------------------|---------|
| `INFO_Information_SIMS_Detail` | Article detail by slug |
| `INFO_Information_SIMS_List` | Paginated list by category |
| `INFO_Information_SIMS_News` | News by SiteMap NodeID |
| `INFO_Information_Router_GetPostBySlug` | Slug → post resolution |
| `INFO_Information_List_ByCateSlug` | List by category slug |
| `INFO_Information_CateList` | Category tree |
| `INFO_Information_GetInfo` | Article by ID (SEO/meta) |
| `INFO_Information_GetTop5_ByCategory` | Sidebar related news |
| `INFO_Information_List_ByCategoryId` | News by category |
| `INFO_Information_List_NotCareer` | Home news excluding career |
| `INFO_Information_Banner` | Homepage banner |
| `INFO_Information_GET_Chat` | Chatbot article corpus |
| `INFO_Chat_GET_ByKeyword` | Chatbot keyword lookup |
| `INFO_AboutPageContent_List` | Structured page blocks |
| `INFO_Career_Search` | Career/major search |
| `sp_News_Search_New` | Full-text news search |
| `HOS_NewsDetail2_GetTopCategories` | Top categories on detail |
| `System_Menu_SearchForWeb` | Navigation menu |

### Media/thumbnail path convention

```csharp
// InformationID 12345 → folder "Information012345"
WebGlobal.InformationThumbDirectory + "/Information" + paddedID + "/" + image
```

Static assets served from `/Media/` (logos, flags, placeholders).

---

## 4. JSON, editor, and player components

| Component | Exists? | Details |
|-----------|---------|---------|
| **JSON API responses** | Partial | `ChatApi.ashx`, `ChatSearch.ashx` via `JavaScriptSerializer` |
| **JSON-LD schema** | Yes | `Detail_Info_Section1.ascx.cs` — SEO `application/ld+json` |
| **Rich text editor** | No | Content is pre-authored HTML from DB |
| **WYSIWYG (CKEditor/TinyMCE)** | No | Not in frontend stack |
| **H5P player** | No | — |
| **Video player (Video.js/Plyr)** | No | YouTube links + theme `popup-video` only |
| **Interactive player** | No | — |
| **Client JSON storage** | Yes | `chatbot.js` — `localStorage` for chat history |

---

## 5. Authentication / permission model

**This public site has no login or authorization.**

- No `FormsAuthentication`, `Authorize`, or role checks in application code
- Session used only for **routing state** (`RouterResolvedSlug`, `RouterPostID`, etc.) and language
- Resource strings reference Login/Permission (`Lang.resx`) — likely for a **separate admin CMS** in `SystemManagement.dll` (not in this repo)
- Chat API: POST-only, no auth token — public endpoint

---

## 6. API patterns

Only **2 HTTP handlers** (ASHX, not Web API / REST):

| Endpoint | Method | File |
|----------|--------|------|
| `/Controls/InformationSection/Information/ChatApi.ashx` | POST JSON `{ message }` → `{ reply }` | `ChatApi.ashx.cs` |
| `/Controls/InformationSection/Information/ChatSearch.ashx` | GET `?q=` → JSON search results | `ChatSearch.ashx.cs` |

Patterns:
- `IHttpHandler`, `IsReusable = false`
- `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`
- `System.Web.Script.Serialization.JavaScriptSerializer` (.NET 4 built-in)
- No Web API, no OData, no SignalR

Routing uses **ASP.NET Routing** (`Global.asax.cs`) + catch-all slug → `Router.aspx`.

---

## 7. Frontend stack

| Library | Version / source |
|---------|------------------|
| **Bootstrap** | **5.0.0-beta1** (`assets\js\app.min.js`) |
| **jQuery** | **3.7.1** (`assets\js\vendor\jquery-3.7.1.min.js`) |
| **Font Awesome** | Bundled (`fontawesome.min.css`) |
| **WOW.js** | 1.1.3 (scroll animations) |
| **CounterUp + Waypoints** | In `app.min.js` |
| **Swiper** | Theme sliders (`th-slider`, `data-slider-options`) |
| **GSAP / Three.js** | `hover-effect.umd.js` (image hover displacement) |
| **Custom theme JS** | `assets\js\main.js` (mobile menu, scroll, preloader) |
| **Chatbot** | Vanilla JS + XHR (`chatbot.js`) — no framework |

Master page load order (`BDS.Master`):

```html
<script src="/assets/js/vendor/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/js/app.min.js"></script>
<script src="/assets/js/main.js"></script>
<script src="/Controls/InformationSection/Information/chatbot.js"></script>
```

**Not used:** React, Vue, Angular, TypeScript, modern bundlers.

---

## 8. Media upload / management

| Component | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| `Controls\Uploader.ascx` | Generic **4-file FileUpload** control; saves to config-driven physical path via `DCore.ConfigManager` (`MaxFileSize_Upload`, `DataFileExtension_Upload`, `PhysicalDirectory_Upload`, `LogicalDirectory_Upload`) |
| `DangKyTuyensinh.ascx` | Has `FileUpload` for ID card, transcript — **submit not implemented** (`// TODO: Validate và lưu dữ liệu`) |
| CMS images | Managed externally (admin CMS); served via `WebGlobal.InformationThumbDirectory` pattern |
| `/Media/` | Static public folder for logos, flags, placeholders |
| Video hosting | **External YouTube** only |

No media library UI, no transcoding, no CDN integration in this codebase.

---

## 9. Gaps vs. H5P-like authoring tool

| H5P capability | Current state | Gap |
|----------------|---------------|-----|
| Interactive content types (quiz, drag-drop, video interactive) | None | Full greenfield |
| JSON content package storage | Only chat/SEO JSON | Need content schema + versioning |
| WYSIWYG authoring UI | None | Need editor or embed H5P |
| Runtime player | None | Need JS player framework |
| xAPI/SCORM tracking | None | Need LMS tracking layer |
| User roles (author/teacher/student) | None on public site | Need auth + RBAC |
| Course/lesson hierarchy | None | Only news categories |
| Gradebook / attempts | None | — |
| Media pipeline | Basic FileUpload only | Need upload API + storage |
| Reusable content library | None | — |
| LTI / embedding | None | — |

**Recommended integration points if building LMS-V1 here:**

1. Use `LMS-V1\Pages\` and `LMS-V1\Controls\` as new module folders inside `InformationWeb`
2. Extend `InformationWebObject` with new entities (`LMS_Lesson`, `LMS_ContentPackage`, etc.)
3. Follow existing `GetDataTable(storedProc, params)` pattern
4. Add ASHX or `.aspx` endpoints for JSON content save/load
5. Reuse `BDS.Master` + Bootstrap 5 frontend shell

---

## 10. Technical constraints

| Constraint | Value |
|------------|-------|
| **.NET version** | **.NET Framework 4.0** |
| **IDE target** | Visual Studio 2010 compatible syntax |
| **Pattern** | WebForms 3-tier via DLLs, stored procedures, `DataTable` |
| **C# style** | Pre-C# 6 — no async/await, no string interpolation in existing code |
| **UI controls** | Telerik 2010, AjaxControlToolkit 4.1 available but barely used in visible code |
| **Missing from repo** | `Web.config`, `InformationWebObject` source, `Utility\*.cs`, `bin\` DLLs, `Document\` DLL folder |
| **Solution** | Single project `InformationWeb.sln` — LMS-V1 not integrated |

---

## Key file paths (quick reference)

| Purpose | Path |
|---------|------|
| Project entry | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\InformationWeb.csproj` |
| LMS scaffold (empty) | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\LMS-V1\` |
| Master layout | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\BDS.Master` |
| Slug router | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\Router.aspx.cs` |
| Article detail | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\Controls\InfomationNew\Detail_Info_Section1.ascx.cs` |
| Article list | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\Controls\InfomationNew\List_Info_Section1.ascx.cs` |
| Chat API | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\Controls\InformationSection\Information\ChatApi.ashx.cs` |
| File upload control | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\Controls\Uploader.ascx.cs` |
| Frontend bundle | `g:\0.LMS\CMS-Video\hos\assets\js\app.min.js` |

---

**Bottom line:** `LMS-V1` is a placeholder. The existing codebase is a **.NET 4 WebForms CMS portal** with news, SEO routing, chatbot, and enrollment UI — a solid foundation for presentation and DB patterns, but **zero LMS or H5P infrastructure**. Building an H5P-like tool would require new database schema, auth, JSON content model, authoring UI, and a client-side player, likely starting inside the empty `LMS-V1` folder and extending the external `InformationWebObject` layer.
